name: LoL Companion
author: DyberPet
description: LoL 全能陪玩：实时解说（Ollama）、对局结束自动统计全队 KDA 并按修仙境界判档生成战报（气泡+通知栏，胜利联动修为）、自动接受对局/自动点赞/自动返回房间（LCU 客户端 API）。

settings_schema.label: Enable Game Companion
settings_schema.description: When turned on, Paimon will commentate your League of Legends matches

settings_schema.label: Commentary Model
settings_schema.description: Local Ollama model used to generate real-time commentary

settings_schema.label: Emotion Reactions
settings_schema.description: When turned on, Paimon will bounce/shake/scale according to the situation

settings_schema.label: Commentary Bubble
settings_schema.description: When turned on, commentary text will pop-up above the pet

settings_schema.label: Battle Report
settings_schema.description: At end of game, count every player's KDA, assign cultivation realms (Qi Refining to Spirit Transformation), and pop up the report (bubble + notification, text only)

settings_schema.label: Win EXP Reward
settings_schema.description: Cultivation EXP granted when the pet's master wins a match (0 disables)

settings_schema.label: Auto Accept Match
settings_schema.description: Automatically accept the match when the ready-check pops up

settings_schema.label: Auto Honor Teammate
settings_schema.description: Automatically honor the best-performing teammate after each game

settings_schema.label: Auto Back to Lobby
settings_schema.description: Automatically return to the lobby a few seconds after the game ends
